subject: dwarfBlacksmith
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: dwarf blacksmith at an anvil.
Style: Blizzard/Warcraft.

spec.name: Stormpeak Forge-Master
spec.description: A stocky Warcraft-style dwarf blacksmith stands hammer raised over an anvil on its stump, beside a coal-glowing forge on a stone workshop ring.
spec.layout: Faces +Z. The dwarf stands centred at x=0, z=-0.15: short massive legs planted apart on the floor, a barrel torso nearly as wide as it is tall, and the head (large, Warcraft proportions) from y1.24 to 1.9 with a tall braided beard spilling down the chest and a steel helm with brass horns. His right arm (world -X) is raised high and back holding a heavy hammer overhead; his left arm reaches forward-and-out to brace a fist on the anvil. The anvil sits on an oak stump at his left-front (x0.6, z0.6), a steel anvil with horn, hardie hole and glowing hot-strip on the face, with an iron-banded quench bucket and a pair of tongs leaning on the stump behind it. Behind the dwarf, the forge: a squat stone furnace fronting +Z, its hearth mouth a bed of glowing embers, with a tapering chimney rising to y2.25 capped in brass, a bellows bolted to its side and tools hanging from a front beam. The whole scene stands on a low circular ring of stone slabs (diameter about 2 m, height 0.14) with moss in the cracks and scattered ember specks; forge, stump and boots rest on y0 inside the ring. The Blizzard style reads in exaggerated proportions (huge shoulders, short legs, big head and beard), chunky faceted shapes, bold gold trim on steel and leather, and warm ember glow against cool grey stone.

parts.builds: A low round ring of workshop ground under the whole scene: 10 to 14 chunky stone slabs laid edge to edge in a circle of radius about 0.95 (use slabs or swept stones, flat tops at y0.14, slightly uneven heights), stone on top faces, stoneDark on sides and gaps; tufts and thin patches of moss seated in three or four slab cracks (moss); inside the ring the packed dark floor (ironDark, very low, or leave the slabs to enclose it); scatter 6 to 8 small ember specks (ember, tiny glowing octahedra or discs) and one or two fallen coal lumps (ironDark) near the forge side and one scorch mark (ink, thin flat disc) between dwarf and forge. Keep it simple: this is the base, not the hero.
parts.attaches: Rests on y=0 itself and is the floor for everything; boots read groundDwarf, forge reads groundForge, stump reads groundAnvil, all inside or beside the ring.

parts.builds: A squat stone forge furnace at z about -1.05 facing +Z: a rounded rectangular stone body (loft or stacked frustum boxes) about 0.9 wide, 0.75 deep, 1.15 tall, built from 8 to 12 visible stone blocks with staggered joints (stone, mortar lines as thin stoneDark inset slabs), a wide arched hearth mouth on the +Z face holding a bed of coals: an ember heap (ironDark mound) topped with 5 to 7 glowing coal chunks (ember with a few emberHot cores, glow applied). A tapering square chimney rises from the back of the body to y2.25 in 3 shrinking stone stages, capped by a brass ring and short flue (gold, with a thin emberHot glow rim under the cap). A heavy leather bellows (two wood boards, wood and woodDark, hinged on an iron pivot at the forge's -X side, leather skin between) angled down toward the hearth with an iron nozzle. A front beam (wood) across the hearth arch with 2 hanging tools: a poker and a shovel (iron rods with ironDark handles) hanging from iron hooks. Gold band across the hearth arch as trim. Glow the coals and the flue rim.
parts.attaches: Forge base rests on the floor at mount groundForge inside the ground ring; its +Z face looks toward the dwarf's back.

parts.builds: The anvil on its stump at x0.6, z0.6, plus its props. The stump: a turned oak trunk section (lathe or faceted cylinder) radius 0.2, height 0.45, wood with vertical woodDark bark streaks and a ring of growth ridges, standing on y=0. The anvil itself on top of the stump: classic shape as a loft or swept body about 0.6 long along +Z-ish (angled about 15 degrees toward the viewer), face height y0.92, with a flat steel face (helmSteel, top facets steelEdge), a tapered horn pointing away from the dwarf (+X side), a hardie hole (small dark square, ironDark) on the face heel, a waisted midsection (iron) and a footed base (ironDark) with a slight flare. On the face, a thin glowing hot-strip (emberHot, glow) near the horn where a red-hot bar lies: a small bent bar (ember, glow) being worked. Props beside the stump: an iron-banded quench bucket (wood body, iron hoops top and bottom, water surface disc) half a meter to the stump's +Z side, with a thin steam wisp hint (one or two small water-tinted puffs); a pair of tongs (two iron rods joined at a rivet, gold rivet) leaning against the stump's -Z side. Keep the anvil crisp and hero-quality: bands, plate and fittings as separate small parts.
parts.attaches: Stump rests on the floor at mount groundAnvil on the ground ring; the anvil face at y0.92 sits just below the dwarf's braced left fist at handL, and the hot bar lies under the raised hammer's swing arc.

parts.builds: The dwarf's lower body and torso, rigged to hips/spine/chest and the leg chains. Legs: short, thick and planted, one sweep or two-segment tube per leg down hipL/kneeL/ankleL and mirrored, ending in chunky boots (frustumBox or stacked boxes) with big squared toes resting flat on the floor at groundDwarf, boots leather with woodDark soles and a small gold buckle on each ankle strap. Torso: a wide barrel chest from a loft or lathe, roughly 0.62 wide at the shoulders and 0.5 deep, barely tapering to the hips, wearing a tunic (tunic) with a lighter chest panel (tunicDark seams as thin inset strips) and a deep V or crossed lacing on the upper chest (leather strips). Over it a heavy blacksmith apron (apron): a broad bib panel from the chest down with a zig-zag or scalloped lower edge (extrude with smoothing, apronDark border strip seated as a separate edge part), hanging from a neck strap; a few tool-scuff patches as small darker inset slabs. Belt: a wide leather belt (leather) with a big gold buckle (gold) and 3 small tool loops (apronDark) around the hips, plus a heavy mallet hanging at the back-left hip (iron head, wood handle). Shoulders: massive pauldron plates (helmSteel with steelEdge rims and gold rivet studs) built at the two shoulder mounts to meet the arms part; a thick fur or leather collar (beardDark) round the neck at neckTop so the head part seats into it. Chest hair tufts or a chain shirt hint at the neckline in beardDark.
parts.attaches: Boots rest on the floor at groundDwarf; the neck collar builds up to mount neckTop where the head part begins; the pauldrons cover the shoulder sockets at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR; the legs ride joints hipL/kneeL/ankleL and hipR/kneeR/ankleR, torso rides hips, spine and chest.

parts.builds: The head and everything on it, riding the head joint (plus jaw). Skull: a big round head (sphere or lathe, radius about 0.17) in skin, squashed slightly wide, with a broad blunt nose (a rounded wedge, skin, skinShadow nostrils as two tiny dark discs), heavy dark brows (two thick ink-to-beardDark slabs angled in a scowl), and small deep-set eyes: two white almonds with dark pupils seated just under the brows, or a simple bold ink-and-white pair; bristling orange sideburn stubble (beardDark, small spikes or cards) along the cheeks. Ears: two small round ears (skin) poking from under the helm. The beard is the signature: a huge braided beard from chin to mid-chest, a solid silhouette mass (extrude or lofted wedge, beard) split into two thick braids plus a central moustache; each braid is a chain-like stack of 4 to 5 tapering segments (beard with beardDark gaps) ending in a gold ring (gold torus or short cylinder) and a small band; a strong chevron moustache (beard) sweeps out over the jaw on both sides of the nose; the beard's lower edge carries a beardDark trim. The jaw joint carries a separate lower-jaw/skin piece under the moustache so the mouth can open. Helm: a deep steel skullcap (lathe, helmSteel) with a nose guard down to the brows (steelEdge edge line), a brow ridge band, a gold band with a small emblazoned roundel at the front, and two short curved brass horns (swept spirals or curved rods, gold) sweeping out and up from the temples; rivet studs (gold dots) along the rim. Everything sits clear of the face: the horns rise above and beside the brows.
parts.attaches: Sits on mount neckTop above the body's collar; geometry rides joints neck, head and jaw; the beard's top tucks into the collar and its tip stops above the chest panel.

parts.builds: Both arms and the smith hammer, riding the arm chains. Right arm (shoulderR, elbowR, handR): raised high and bent back overhead, one tapering tube or two sweeps per segment in skin (bare forearm) with a rolled tunic sleeve cap at the shoulder (tunic) and a bracer (leather with gold buckle) on the forearm; the fist is a big chunky gauntlet (iron with steelEdge knuckle studs, 4 finger slabs plus thumb wrapping a haft). It grips a massive smith hammer held vertical, head up: a thick wood handle (wood with woodDark grip wrap) about 0.55 long and an oversized iron head (iron with steelDark striking faces and steelEdge bevels, a gold band at the neck of the head); the head sits clear at about y1.9, posed so its strike arc sweeps toward the anvil. Left arm (shoulderL, elbowL, handL): reaching forward-down to the anvil, same sleeve and bracer construction, fist (same gauntlet build) planted flat on the anvil face near the hot bar at mount side of the anvilStation part. Both deltoids hide under the body part's pauldrons: build only from the shoulder mount outward so the pauldron overlaps the socket. Elbow and knuckle details as small steelEdge plates. This part carries the silhouette's drama: make the raised arm and hammer read boldly from the front.
parts.attaches: Upper arms root at mounts shoulderR and shoulderL under the body's pauldrons; geometry rides shoulderR/elbowR/handR and shoulderL/elbowL/handL; the left fist lands on the anvil face of the anvilStation part and the hammer head hangs in the swing arc above it.
